title: Detect dead panes and mark their tasks abandoned
done_when: Shipped. Tasks whose target pane process has exited reach a terminal 'abandoned' status, distinct from cancelled and overdue (src-tauri/src/mcp.rs, abandon_lost and Shared::reconcile_abandoned). SessionManager::liveness probes each child with try_wait and reports a failed probe as alive, so a bad probe never discards work (src-tauri/src/lib.rs). Reconciliation runs on roster read, dispatch and task collection; list_sessions marks a dead pane DEAD and dispatch refuses it. 13 tests cover the transition, including that live-but-slow panes and already-terminal work are untouched. Verified 2026-08-22: 114 tests pass, fmt and clippy clean.
